title: •Advantage
caption: •Advantage (V)
game_text: Deploy on your battleground. During battle, whenever opponent’s card is hit by a non-{lightsaber} (once per card targeted), opponent’s total power is cumulatively -4 (-2 if hit by a lightsaber).
lore: With only a few Jedi remaining in the galaxy, each confrontation between them has far reaching consequences.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT (printed base is a Cloud City Immediate Effect; the slip makes it a plain Effect, no grabber box). Inline black square with a green diagonal blade after 'non-' → {lightsaber} (stub reads 'non-lightsaber'). Curly apostrophes in opponent’s (twice). Base page 'Advantage' = printed archive face (stub's Decipher base; 'Advantage (Original)' is the same face). The 745 px CC-L-advantage.gif is tagged D-E1 (PC errata face, reworded game text) — downloaded to src/vs11/01-CC-L-advantage.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore matches both scans. Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px; non-pre also exists, not downloaded).
